changes: Fixes the running NewzDeck window showing the Microsoft Edge/Chrome taskbar icon on fresh Windows installations.
Assigns the hosted Chromium NewzDeck application window the explicit NewzDeck.Desktop AppUserModelID plus NewzDeck relaunch command, display name, and icon metadata.
Applies the NewzDeck icon to the hosted window for taskbar/Alt-Tab/title surfaces while leaving unrelated browser windows untouched.
Reapplies the identity for a bounded startup window because Chromium can populate or replace window properties after the HWND first appears.
Preserves the existing Edge/Chrome localhost application-host architecture and uses the same NewzDeck.exe launch path; no separate taskbar shim is shipped in production.
Preserves all accepted v3.6.4 Newsgroup Package Browser & Binary Reconstruction behavior and earlier installer/runtime/download/Automation/Discover fixes.
